mode: binary 3D vertical AND FeFET; digital local CIM

state.gate_channel: 6 nm SL-HZO / 4 nm O-poor IGO; O-0.1s grain process for disturb immunity
state.compatibility: SL+O-poor switching and O-0.1s disturbance results are used together as a process-compatible reference condition; the paper does not report a complete CMOS macro with these timings.
state.precision: Exact signed INT8 arithmetic conditional on correct binary sensing and accepted writes; no additional algorithm error threshold.
state.retention_policy: No periodic refresh or destructive-read restore in the modeled local service window; lifetime and cumulative disturbance treated separately.

mapping.strip_definition: One local WL segment per layer, four stacked layers and sixteen BL/SL column pairs; one output group and one binary weight plane.
mapping.physical_address: weight[o,i] bit b -> lane=i%32; layer=i//32; strip=(o//16)*8+b; column=o%16
mapping.read_layer_selection: Each row lane selects one layer; other layers held off. Thirty-two lateral row lanes, not four stack layers, supply concurrent operands.

resident.alignment: One input index and sixteen contiguous outputs aligned to an output group; eight binary planes complete one transaction.
resident.write_bias_scheme: For polarity s: selected WL=2sVw/3; other layer WL=sVw/3; target BL=SL=-sVw/3; inhibited BL=SL=+sVw/3. Positive phase targets ones, negative phase targets zeroes.
resident.guard_source: FENOR-02 p.2 Fig.3(d), RAWD<100 ns; includes final bias return, which is not added again
resident.verify_policy: One terminal binary read of all cells in the physical batch, then 16-wide compare. Failed verify flags an exception; no invented retry probability or repeat count.

includes: read bias establishment and local RC
anchors: FENOR-02 p.2 Fig.5(c): -0.5 V, 20 ns read endurance stress pulse; not full read-cycle measurement
FENOR-02 p.3 Fig.11(d): TCAD-extracted RC/SPICE read latency over layer count; not measured macro
FENOR-02 p.3 Fig.10: array binary threshold states
engineering_read_budget.meaning: 20/40/80 ns are complete local binary-read engineering allowances for the stated lateral resources, not extracted confidence bounds; no ADC is used.

engineering_driver_budget.node_count_definition: 16 independently controlled BLs + 16 SLs + 4 layer WL segments
engineering_driver_budget.scope: Local level-shifted rail drivers and isolation, not a measured FeFET driver macro; C and current are explicit design limits that support 5/10/20 ns transitions. Supply rails are already available locally. No off-boundary rail startup is claimed.
engineering_driver_budget.source_bridge: FENOR-02 p.3 Fig.9 supplies voltage selection; Fig.11 supplies RC scale. Neither supplies measured bias-driver settling.

structural_contrast.description: Eight weight-plane strips of the same aligned 16-weight word share two polarity phases under one controller. Requires eight times the write line drivers and rail transient capacity. Uses 128 existing binary sense nodes and eight compare ticks; does not multiply B_R or independent service units.

exceptions.r0_value: 32 rows x 16 outputs x 8 weight bits per read round
exceptions.configured_value: Unchanged operand width, realized with 32 separate lateral row lanes; only one of four shared-BL layers selected per lane
exceptions.reason: FENOR-02 vertical AND topology and FENOR-01 horizontal n-bit weight/sense structure require explicit independent sense paths. Stack height alone provides no operand parallelism.
exceptions.consequence: 4096 binary sense nodes plus 16 digital reduction lanes; same capacity on both services.

exceptions.r0_value: 128-bit encoded-data interface, physical write width unspecified
exceptions.configured_value: 16-cell local strip in main design; W128 contrasts 128 cells
exceptions.reason: FENOR-02 measured 4x16x16 array supports local selection and disturb pattern, not a 128-cell driver guarantee
exceptions.consequence: Eight sequential physical write batches complete one 16-Byte logical transaction; W128 adds the explicit driver resources.

exceptions.r0_value: Replace covered stages if complete macro timing exists
exceptions.configured_value: No complete macro timing claimed; 20 ns write plateau, 100 ns post-pulse guard, read/verify, interface and digital stages separately budgeted
exceptions.reason: FENOR-02 separates switching, RAWD, array pattern, and simulated RC
exceptions.consequence: Final return is inside post-pulse guard, and read budget is used once before each digital round or terminal verify.

observation_sensitivity.fixed: 16-cell strip, 40 ns complete binary read, 10 ns transition, 5 ns TD, two 20 ns plateaus; terminal verify retained
observation_sensitivity.meaning: 100 ns remains the conservative reference; 150 ns tests 50 ns additional engineering reserve, not a measured upper bound or physical uncertainty interval. RAWD < 100 ns does not establish a specific shorter waiting time.
observation_sensitivity.source_locator: local PDF p.2 Fig.3(d), Read @ -0.5 V, RAWD < 100 ns; caption minimal read latency < 100 ns
observation_sensitivity.coverage: Chosen observation starts at final write plateau end and includes final write-bias return; complete binary read starts afterwards and includes read-bias setup/sensing/read recovery. This conservative schedule has no separately added final write return. The original plot does not decompose those stages.
